review_method: User-confirmed non-clinician reference labeling, AI-assisted source review
reference_date_policy: Historical snapshot (2021-11-30); explicit time windows and measurement qualifiers respected
on_therapy_policy: An active documented prescribed regimen may support an unwindowed 'on therapy' criterion without proving drug administration/adherence. Explicit use/administration windows require actual use evidence.

labels.criterion_text: irrespective of sex;
labels.reason: The inclusion statement imposes no sex restriction. The documented male patient falls within the unrestricted category.
labels.review_notes: Nonrestrictive criterion; evaluated MET under the agreed three-label rubric.

labels.criterion_text: aged between 45 and 79 years;
labels.reason: Patient age at reference date 2021-11-30 is 52 years, within the stated 45–79 year range.
labels.review_notes: Age explicitly calculated as of the frozen historical reference date.

labels.criterion_text: with office-measured seated BP 120-139 mm Hg systolic and below 90 mm Hg diastolic;
labels.reason: The latest documented BP was 114/79 mmHg on 2021-08-13 (systolic below the requested 120–139 range). An older 126/74 mmHg reading was within the numeric range, but the record does not establish that either measurement is a seated office BP meeting the specified screening condition.
missing_information: A verified seated office BP measurement for the relevant screening assessment.
labels.review_notes: Do not cherry-pick the older in-range observation or treat generic BP as verified seated office BP.

labels.criterion_text: diagnosed of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), currently on diabetic therapy;
labels.reason: The patient has a documented type 2 diabetes-associated neuropathy diagnosis and an active insulin MedicationRequest dated 2021-08-13. Under the proposed operational definition, 'currently on diabetic therapy' refers to a documented active treatment regimen, not proven dose administration or adherence.
labels.review_notes: PROPOSED policy clarification: an active medication order is sufficient for 'on therapy', but NOT for an explicit 'administration/use within 1 month' criterion. The MedicationRequest's derived status_at_reference_date is undetermined, so this interpretation must be approved before labels are frozen.

labels.criterion_text: informed consent provided and long-term follow-up possible
labels.reason: The record does not establish trial-specific informed consent or the feasibility of long-term follow-up.
missing_information: Documentation of trial informed consent and long-term follow-up feasibility.
labels.review_notes: Consent to ordinary medical care is not synonymous with research consent.

labels.criterion_text: poor control of blood glucose, HbA1c \> 10.0%
labels.reason: The latest recorded HbA1c was 3.6% (2021-08-13), not above the exclusion threshold of 10.0%.
labels.review_notes: Historical numeric comparison; no explicit additional window in the trial criterion. Synthetic value accepted as recorded.

labels.criterion_text: administration of any antihypertensive medications within 1 month;
labels.reason: Active lisinopril and amlodipine MedicationRequests were recorded on 2021-08-13, but there are no dated administration/use records documenting antihypertensive medication consumption within the month before 2021-11-30.
missing_information: Confirmed administration/use of an antihypertensive drug in the required one-month window, or explicit evidence of no use.
labels.review_notes: MedicationRequest is an order, not evidence of administration; August order date is outside the one-month window.

labels.criterion_text: a history of hypoglycemic coma / seizure;
labels.reason: No explicit documented history or negative-history assessment for hypoglycemic coma or seizure is available.
missing_information: Documented presence or explicit absence of hypoglycemic coma/seizure history.
labels.review_notes: No matching Condition alone is not proof of absence.

labels.criterion_text: confirmed diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus;
labels.reason: A type 2 diabetes-related diagnosis is documented, but the chart does not explicitly establish the presence or absence of a separate confirmed type 1 diabetes diagnosis.
missing_information: An explicit verified type 1 diabetes diagnosis or documented negative history/assessment.
labels.review_notes: Do not infer absence of T1D only from documented T2D.

labels.criterion_text: alanine-aminotransferase (ALT) or aspartate-aminotransferase (AST) over three times the upper limit of normal;
labels.reason: No ALT or AST laboratory measurements with a source-supported upper limit of normal were identified in the complete normalized facts.
missing_information: ALT/AST results and corresponding upper-limit-of-normal reference ranges.
labels.review_notes: Do not import external reference ranges to fill a missing source range.

labels.criterion_text: estimated glomerular filtration rate \< 45 ml/min/1.73m2;
labels.reason: The latest recorded eGFR was 64.8 mL/min/1.73 m² (2021-08-13), not below the specified 45 mL/min/1.73 m² exclusion threshold.
labels.review_notes: Historical numeric comparison; no additional time window in the criterion.

labels.criterion_text: a history of congestive heart failure with left ventricular ejection fraction \< 40%;
labels.reason: The record does not establish a history of congestive heart failure with left ventricular ejection fraction below 40%, nor an explicit comprehensive negative assessment.
missing_information: Documented CHF history and LV ejection fraction, or an explicit negative history encompassing the criterion.
labels.review_notes: Other cardiovascular measurements cannot substitute for LVEF.

labels.criterion_text: coronary artery disease requiring RAS blockers for secondary prevention;
labels.reason: A lisinopril prescription and hypertension diagnosis exist, but no evidence establishes coronary artery disease requiring RAS blockade for secondary prevention, nor explicitly rules it out.
missing_information: Coronary artery disease history and the indication for RAS-blocker therapy, or an explicit negative assessment.
labels.review_notes: A RAS-blocker prescription does not prove the CAD secondary-prevention indication.

labels.criterion_text: acute on-set of stroke within 6 months prior to randomization;
labels.reason: No verified positive or negative history of acute stroke is documented, and the intended randomization date is unspecified.
missing_information: Stroke history/date or explicit absence within six months and the relevant randomization date.
labels.review_notes: Reference date is not automatically the trial randomization date.

labels.criterion_text: a ratio of urinary albumin (in mg/L) to urinary creatinine (in g/L) (ACR) ≥ 300 mg/g;
labels.reason: The latest documented urinary albumin/creatinine ratio was 16.96 mg/g (2021-08-13), below the exclusion threshold of ≥300 mg/g.
labels.review_notes: The source observation directly reports a mg/g ratio; no external conversion needed.

labels.criterion_text: known contraindications for the active study medications;
labels.reason: Known contraindications cannot be assessed without identifying the active study medications and verifying patient-specific contraindications.
missing_information: Identity of active study medications and patient-specific contraindication history/assessment.
labels.review_notes: Do not equate absent contraindication codes with documented absence.

labels.criterion_text: a history of psychological or mental disorder;
labels.reason: Stress is documented as a finding, but this does not itself establish a diagnosed psychological/mental disorder. No explicit comprehensive negative psychiatric history is supplied.
missing_information: A qualifying psychiatric diagnosis/history or documented negative history/assessment.
labels.review_notes: Psychological stress and screening scores should not be automatically converted into a psychiatric diagnosis.

labels.criterion_text: pregnancy or currently planning to have babies or lactation;
labels.reason: The recorded administrative sex is male, but the record does not comprehensively establish the status of all alternatives, especially whether the patient is currently planning to have a baby.
missing_information: Relevant pregnancy/lactation status if applicable and explicit reproductive-planning information.
labels.review_notes: This is an OR criterion; do not infer the planning component from male administrative sex.

labels.criterion_text: severe diseases such as severe heart diseases;
labels.reason: The phrase severe diseases, such as severe heart diseases, requires a clinical severity and applicability judgment not established by the available structured facts.
missing_information: Clinical evaluation of severe disease or explicit absence of relevant severe illness.
labels.review_notes: Do not infer severe disease from unrelated diagnoses alone.

labels.criterion_text: an expected residual life span less than 3 years;
labels.reason: No documented prognosis supports or rules out an expected remaining lifespan shorter than three years.
missing_information: An explicit clinical prognosis/expected survival assessment.
labels.review_notes: Absence of a death date is not a life-expectancy estimate.

labels.criterion_text: a malignancy that clinical investigators consider as unsuitable to participate;
labels.reason: No investigator assessment establishes whether any malignancy makes this patient unsuitable for study participation; lack of a cancer code does not establish the converse.
missing_information: Malignancy status/history and investigator-specific suitability assessment.
labels.review_notes: Investigator judgment cannot be inferred from records alone.

labels.criterion_text: currently participating in another clinical trial.
labels.reason: No explicit clinical-trial participation status as of the reference date is documented.
missing_information: Documented current participation in another trial or verified absence.
labels.review_notes: No trial-related resource is not proof of nonparticipation.
